description: This Java source file defines the LayoutEvents class, which contains static methods for handling content layout operations such as creating, updating, cloning, and replacing layout images and sub-contents within the Apache OFBiz framework. It interacts with entities, services, and processors to manage content resources and associations.

classes.name: LayoutEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for managing content layout operations such as creating, updating, cloning, and replacing images and sub-contents within OFBiz.

methods.name: createLayoutImage
methods.description: Handles uploading and persisting a new layout image, associating it with content, and updating related data resources.

methods.name: updateLayoutImage
methods.description: Updates an existing layout image with new image data and metadata.

methods.name: replaceSubContent
methods.description: Replaces a sub-content resource with a new one, updating associations accordingly.

methods.name: cloneLayout
methods.description: Clones an existing layout, including its content and associated data resources, creating new entities and associations.

methods.name: createLayoutSubContent
methods.description: Creates a new sub-content and its association within the layout.

methods.name: updateLayoutSubContent
methods.description: Updates an existing sub-content's data and associations.

methods.name: copyToClip
methods.description: Copies an entity's primary key attributes to the clipboard for reuse.
